title: erdify JSON output, schema_version 1
description: The document `erdify --format json` writes. Documented in https://erdify.devsuit.io/usage/output-formats/#json. Keys added later are allowed: consumers must ignore keys they do not know. New `source`, relationship `type` and edge `kind` values may be added in a minor release; this file is updated in place then.

edges.description: The relationship lines the diagram draws, in diagram order. Empty when relationships are disabled (--no-relationships).

enums.description: Every parsed enum, drawn or not (see used_by). Empty when enums are disabled (--no-enums).

name.description: Class name (or table name for SQL DDL). Unique within the document: same-name SQL tables in different schemas are named schema.table; one declared without a schema keeps its bare name. Same-name model classes in different modules are named module.Class when more than one of them is drawn.

schema.description: The database schema the table is in, when the source names one.

source.description: The framework the entity was read from.

module.description: The dotted Python module the class is defined in; null for SQL DDL.

app.description: The Django app label; null for every other source.

is_link_table.description: true for a detected many-to-many join table.

type.description: Type as written in the source (or the mapped Python type).

foreign_table.description: Referenced table.column when foreign_key is true; schema.table.column when the source names the schema, when SQLAlchemy resolves an unqualified target in its MetaData(schema=...), or, for SQL DDL, when the table the reference resolves to is in a schema (an unresolved reference keeps the schema it names).

unique.description: Column is unique on its own. Always false on a table's only primary-key column.

default.description: Default value as source text, if any.

nullable.description: true when a one relationship's annotation admits None; false otherwise.

inverse.description: The other side's attribute, when the source names it (back_populates=).

from_entity.description: Name of the entity the edge starts at.

to_entity.description: Name of the entity the edge ends at.

from_end.description: How many from_entity rows relate to one to_entity row.

to_end.description: How many to_entity rows relate to one from_entity row.

label.description: The foreign-key column or relationship attribute the edge is labelled with.

used_by.description: Names of the entities with a field of this enum, in entity order (as in edge endpoints). The diagrams draw an enum only when this is not empty. Added in 1.9.0.
